fields.description: Enable the AI Procurement Copilot agent in the NextGen AI assistant.
fields.label: Enable Procurement Copilot

fields.description: Typhoon model for the procurement agent. Falls back to Staff Chat Model when blank.
fields.label: Procurement Model

fields.description: Warehouse used for procurement previews when the user did not explicitly choose one.
fields.label: Default Buying Warehouse

fields.description: Shadow: recommendations only, never creates buying documents. Approval Required: confirmed previews create Draft documents. Automatic: gated auto-creation of submitted Material Requests.
fields.label: Automation Mode

fields.description: Separate, stricter flag. Even in Automatic mode, direct Purchase Order submission stays disabled unless this is on.
fields.label: Allow Direct PO Submission (Automatic Mode)

fields.description: Safety stock = max(Item.safety_stock, average daily demand × this)
fields.label: Safety Stock (Days of Demand)

fields.description: History shorter than this lowers the data-quality score and adds a warning.
fields.label: Minimum Data (Days)

fields.description: Used when the item has no lead time configured.
fields.label: Default Supplier Lead Time (Days)

fields.description: One Item Group per line. Empty analyzes all purchase items.
fields.label: Allowed Item Groups

fields.description: One Warehouse per line. Empty uses the default buying warehouse.
fields.label: Allowed Warehouses

fields.description: Automatic mode stops creating documents once today's auto-created total reaches this (0 disables the limit).
fields.label: Daily Auto Spend Limit

fields.description: One Item code per line. Automatic mode only ever touches these items.
fields.label: Automatic Mode Item Allowlist

fields.description: One Supplier per line. Empty means any linked supplier is acceptable for Automatic mode.
fields.label: Approved Suppliers
